Hydroelectricity data on the openmod wiki

description: Swiss data is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Hydroelectricity data > Swiss data", published or maintained by bafu.admin.ch (publisher inferred from the link). Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Hydroelectricity data" lists it under "Swiss data". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hydroelectricity inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
licence: not stated on the wiki page (source page not read)
